response.overview: In a university classroom, there are only two students left to face their oral exam in Criminal Law under the watchful eye of the demanding Professor Peña. Mario, a veteran and clumsy student, barely manages to get out of the way. Clara, her friend and brilliant companion, dazzles with her answers. But after her speech, the teacher asks an unexpected question: what grade does Mario deserve? The grade decided by the student will be her final grade. What seemed like a gesture of friendship becomes an ethical dilemma when Clara discovers that her decision may cost her her professional future.
response.title: Nota de corte
